1.alt: Randall drives a blue car along a curving road with both arms thrown up, staring at a tall yellow construction crane, while Samantha sits beside him looking alarmed.
transcript: Randall: Look Samantha! A crane!
Samantha: Not again! Why do engineers have to be fascinated with cranes? We’re gonna crash!

2.alt: Randall lies sick in bed, glaring and pulling tissues from a box, with used tissues scattered around, while Samantha sits on the edge of the bed.
transcript: Randall: This is all your fault... You got me sick because YOU talk to REAL people.

3.alt: Outside a store's fitting rooms, Samantha carries an armful of purple clothes while Randall, in a yellow T-shirt, waits holding his phone.
transcript: Sign: fitting rooms
Randall: Finally... I read like 20 pages of Reddit!
Samantha: You measure time by reading Reddit? Interesting.

4.alt: Samantha and Randall sit at a wooden table with two tablets on it; Randall holds an energy drink and grins.
transcript: Samantha: I know that I’m a good writer because people have told me so.
Randall: I know that I’m a good writer because of my conversion rates!
Caption: I don’t know what conversion rates are but he says this to me....

5.alt: Samantha, in a pink top, throws her arms up excitedly about their wedding while Randall shrugs with his palms up and a sly smile.
transcript: Samantha: I want our wedding to be simple and fun and perfect!
Randall: How about a LAN party?!

6.alt: Randall stands proudly with hands on hips beside a tall bookcase packed with his programming books, while Samantha, hands clasped, eyes it skeptically.
transcript: Randall: Pretty 1337, huh? I’ve got them organized categorically: web design, Python, Unix internals, algorithms, cryptography, databases and C!

7.alt: At a couples counselor's office with a "love doctor" door sign, Samantha sits worried while Randall, in a Linux penguin T-shirt, grins at a laptop showing the Steam logo.
transcript: Sign: love doctor
Samantha: So the Mayans were right?
Counselor: I’m sorry, this may be the end for you two...
Caption: Steam for Linux: why everything will stop in 2012

8.alt: Samantha, in a light blue dress, holds up Randall's new notebook and a pencil while Randall stands with one finger raised, explaining.
transcript: Samantha: Why did you buy a moleskin notebook?
Randall: So that one day it will be framed in a museum where people will admire my API sketches and say, “What an exquisite man.”
Samantha: You really want to be the Ron Burgundy of programming huh?

9.alt: Walking Scribbles on a leash, Randall clutches his head in frustration at a jogger running in place at a red traffic light, while Samantha gestures toward the jogger.
transcript: Randall: Aahh! It’s one of those joggers again! I don’t understand!!
Samantha: What’s wrong? He’s just keeping his heart rate up until he crosses the street.
Randall: Running in place defies logic! He’s not going anywhere! Oh the inefficiency!

10.alt: Samantha, in a red dress and holding a bowl of popcorn, cheers in front of a TV while Randall stands behind her looking unimpressed.
transcript: Samantha: Wooohoo TRON! Go open source! Great movie!
Randall: ...Except that programs don’t have emotions, so that kind of nullifies the whole thing...

11.alt: Samantha throws her arms up in exasperation as Randall, knees bent, struggles to carry three stacked flats of Rockstar energy drinks.
transcript: Samantha: Why did you buy 3 flats of energy drinks?!
Randall: This is all I can carry, Samantha! I tried to get more!

12.alt: Seen from behind, Randall sits at his desk in heart-print boxers with his feet up, on a phone call while a cartoon plays on his laptop; energy drink cans, snacks and Scribbles in his bed surround him.
transcript: Randall: No this is a good time... I’m available. What’s up? Sure, let’s start the conference call then...

13.alt: Samantha, in a purple top, hugs and tickles Randall, who throws one arm in the air and yells.
transcript: Randall: STOP!! I’m begging! Tickling is against the Geneva Coventions!

14.alt: Samantha's hand holds up a pink anniversary card covered in scrawled, unreadable handwriting, while Randall stands nearby scratching his head.
transcript: [The card is covered in scribbled, illegible handwriting, with a clear "<3" near the bottom above an illegible signature.]
Samantha: Honey, the only thing legible in this card is a less-than symbol and a three!
Randall: That’s a heart sweetie!

15.alt: Samantha sits smiling with a laptop, Scribbles peeking out of a cornucopia basket at her feet, while Randall stands with his hands clasped, frowning.
transcript: Samantha: OMG! A pilgrim name generator! It says you’re Cuthbert Cuthbertson!  And it says Scribbles is Cuthbert Cuthbertson too!
Randall: Sounds like those programmers forgot to seed their random number generator!

16.alt: Randall happily holds up his laptop and an energy drink, while Samantha, wearing an apron and holding a spray bottle and cleaning rag, looks at him.
transcript: Randall: Ah, you know that nice feeling you get when everything is all clean and tidy? I feel like that, because I finally organized all my Dropbox files!
Samantha: Oh... I thought you noticed that I just cleaned the kitchen.

17.alt: Randall excitedly points at Samantha and pumps his fist after asking her a question; a second image is a Wikipedia excerpt defining white hat and black hat hackers.
transcript: Randall: Are you a black hat or a white hat?!
Samantha: Black?
Randall: Yes! I knew it!
[Second image: an excerpt from Wikipedia.]
Excerpt: White hat

Excerpt: A "white hat hacker" (also known as an ethical hacker) breaks security for non-malicious reasons, perhaps to test their own personal security system, or while working for a company that needs intensive security assurance. Many hackers in this classification perform penetration tests and vulnerability assessments within a contractual agreement. Some black hat hackers will transfer over into becoming a white hat hacker after they get caught illegally breaking into a system whose company sees value in having somebody with this level of knowledge work for them.
Excerpt: Black hat

Excerpt: A "black hat hacker" (also known as a cracker) is a hacker who violates computer security with malicious intent or for personal gain. Black hat hackers form the stereotypical illegal hacking groups often portrayed in pop culture, and are "the epitome of all that the public fears in a computer criminal". Black hat hackers break into secure networks to destroy data or make the network unusable for those who are authorized to use the network. They choose their targets using a two-pronged process known as the "pre-hacking stage".

18.alt: Samantha sits at a laptop looking startled while Randall stands behind her clutching his head in dismay.
transcript: Randall: No! When you talk to my friends online, you have to use my handle, not my real name!

19.alt: Randall sits on the floor holding his head in frustration while Samantha lounges beside him with a drink, each talking about their own problem.
transcript: Randall: I’ve spent two days troubleshooting.....
Samantha: I think I need a hair cut.
Randall: I should’ve used memcached!
Samantha: Look at these split ends!
Randall: What are split ends?
Samantha: What’s memcached?

20.alt: Samantha, in a teal dress, carries shopping bags while Randall points eagerly off toward a store.
transcript: Randall: Oooh! Can we go to Staples!? In grade school, all the cool guys and I would save up our lunch money and buy the coolest and newest mechanical pencils like Dr. Grip. Then we would trade them! They were worth more than pens because they had erasers!
Samantha: Wow, you’re so much cooler than I thought.

21.alt: Randall and Samantha lie side by side in bed in the morning, each reading news on their phone; Randall smiles while Samantha looks upset.
transcript: Randall: There’s a baby pug practicing high fives on /r/Awww.
Samantha: Omg, the Syrian government might use chemical weapons!

22.alt: Randall sits at his laptop between cans of Rockstar energy drink while Samantha, in an "I ♥ my geek" shirt, stands behind him touching his hair with a grimace.
transcript: Samantha: Ew...your hair feels crunchy.
Randall: That’s because I rotate my headphones every 30 minutes to equally distribute the pressure on my scalp.

23.alt: Randall looks glum as he worries about their relationship, and Samantha, in a purple dress, raises her hands and makes him an offer.
transcript: Randall: As a couple, we don’t have much in common. How are we going to have fun together?
Samantha: Okay, I’ll join a guild with you if that’s what you want.

24.alt: Four panels: Scribbles sits in a pile of heart-print underwear, Randall stands smugly with hands on hips, a close-up shows his shorts, and Samantha closes her eyes, unamused.
transcript: Samantha: Randall! Scribbles is in your underwear!
[Scribbles sits in a pile of laundry with heart-print underwear draped over his head.]
[Panel 2]
Randall: All the best things are under my underwear...
[Panel 3]
[Close-up of Randall's shorts, with a dashed red outline of the underwear he's wearing underneath.]
[Panel 4]
Samantha: Hmph!

25.alt: At an Apple store with the glowing apple logo overhead, Samantha, in a purple dress, holds back a fist-shaking Randall as he lunges toward the display tables.
transcript: Randall: Stupid shiny unix rip offs! “Geniuses” my ass!
Samantha: Not again, Randall!

26.alt: Samantha, wrapped in a towel and standing on a bathroom scale, looks shocked as Randall peeks cheerfully around the door.
transcript: Samantha: Randall! Why does the scale have a picture of me with my name on it?
Randall: Don’t you love it? It uploads our BMI,fat percentage and weight to an online chart so we can keep track!

27.alt: Samantha and Randall sit side by side in a church pew, seen from behind. Randall's thought bubble puts the Flying Spaghetti Monster over the cross at the front.
transcript: [No dialogue.]
[Randall's thought bubble shows the Flying Spaghetti Monster, a tangle of noodles with two meatballs and eyes on stalks, in front of the cross.]

28.alt: Randall stands sadly beside a Christmas tree with an empty stocking and torn wrapping paper on the floor, while Samantha, in pajamas, cheerfully offers to help.
transcript: Randall: I’m jealous. Mike got a Raspberry Pi for Christmas.
Samantha: Don’t be silly, I’ll whip one up for you sweetie!
Randall: It’s a credit-card sized programmable computer!
Samantha: ...Oh.

29.alt: In a drab office full of cubicles, Samantha sits at her desk clutching a desk phone and pleading with the person on the line.
transcript: Samantha: Wait! What’s India like? Don’t go! Please, it’s so boring here!

30.alt: Randall talks in his sleep in bed while Samantha sits up next to him, puzzled, and Scribbles lies at the foot of the bed.
transcript: Randall: Zzzzz..... No!...No...I’m not installing anymore servers... Zzzzz
[Samantha has a thought bubble with a question mark.]

31.alt: Three panels of Samantha at her office desk in a pink top, on the phone with tech support and growing more exasperated.
transcript: Samantha: Soooo it took 8 seconds to return a ping?
[Panel 2]
Samantha: And just to clarify, you’re saying that’s normal?
[Panel 3]
Samantha: Thanks a lot.

32.alt: Randall excitedly tells an unimpressed Samantha about a friend's beard. By the last panel both have heart eyes, picturing a glowing bearded figure on a hill above tiny worshippers.
transcript: Randall: My friend Alven’s going to grow his beard out for a whole year!
Samantha: So?
[Panel 2]
Randall: A beard like that on a developer is like having the golden fleece on your face!
Randall: It will have powers!
[Panel 3]
Randall and Samantha: Oooohh...
[Their shared thought bubble shows a radiant man with a huge white beard standing on a hill above tiny cheering stick figures.]

33.alt: Samantha, in a green dress, has lunch at a small café table with a woman friend in a yellow sweater and jeans. The two are comparing their husbands' complaints.
transcript: Samantha: My husband always complains about people not putting sufficient comments in their code.
Friend: ....Interesting. My husband complains when his patients don’t brush their 2nd bicuspids. He’s a dentist.

34.alt: Randall stands dejected while Samantha, in a white top and green skirt, holds Scribbles in her arms and answers him.
transcript: Randall: I posted on Facebook that I finished my book and nobody said anything. Then I put a picture of you and Scribbles on there and everyone liked it!
Samantha: Don’t hate me ‘cause I’m beautiful!

35.alt: At a paint-your-own-ceramics studio, Samantha paints a crane on a blue vase while Randall, in a 1337 shirt, paints a tile. A blonde staff member in an apron comes over to their table.
transcript: Samantha: This is the best date ever! I love Paint-Your-Own Ceramic!
Randall: Yup.
[Panel 2]
Samantha: I’m painting a magical crane! Me looves it!
Randall: I’m painting hexadecimal!
[Randall's tile reads: \x48\x61\x69\x6C \x53\x61\x74\x61\x6E]
[Panel 3]
Staff member: Aw, what a cute couple! What do all those numbers mean, young man?
Randall: It’s hexadecimal for Hail Satan.
[Samantha looks horrified.]

36.alt: Two mothers, one in purple and one in cream, brag about their sons' computer books. Below, they admit they're lost as a man in a teal shirt and tie points upward to explain.
transcript: Mom in purple: My son wrote a book. It’s about computers!
Mom in cream: So did my son!
[Panel 2]
Mom in purple: I don’t understand it though.
Mom in cream: Me neither.
Dad: Heroku is a type of karate, Honey!

37.alt: Randall proudly points to a calculator in his hand as Samantha, in a purple top and jeans, stares back at him in dismay.
transcript: Randall: According to my calculations, we only need $2.7 million dollars to live off $40,000 a year at a 2% interest rate!
Samantha: We need $2.7 million!

38.alt: Randall walks Scribbles on a leash and grins, while Samantha, in a teal top and skirt, clutches her head.
transcript: Randall: I found the best music to program to!
Samantha: That’s soo nerdy!

39.alt: Randall sits at his laptop between cans of Rockstar energy drink, fists raised and yelling in frustration.
transcript: Randall: Damn! One 'ab' command and I'm locked out of my new web service!

40.alt: Randall shows Samantha the new motivational posters in his home office. Later, she finds him hunched over his laptop.
transcript: [Posters on the wall read “HAVE PASSION” and “COMMIT 100%” (partly hidden behind Samantha).]
Randall: I got motivational posters for my office, Sweetie!
Samantha: Oooh. I’ll leave you alone so that you can be “motivated” and focus!
[Panel 2]
[Night falls outside the window as Randall sits hunched over his laptop.]
[Panel 3]
[Daytime again.]
Samantha: You’ve been gaming this whole time!?
Randall: It’s tower defense!

41.alt: Randall lies sprawled on the floor next to an open book while Samantha, in a pink dress, kneels beside him with her hand on her forehead.
transcript: Samantha: OMG! What happened!? Do you have food poisoning?
Randall: Samantha....HELP... The ending was so sad. I can’t move.
Samantha: Were you reading this? This isn’t a technical book... It’s a novel! Randall! You’re having something called an emotional reaction.
Randall: I’m never reading fiction again.

42.alt: Randall, beaming, sweeps Samantha, in a purple dress, into a big hug and lifts her off her feet.
transcript: Randall: You signed up for Github!

43.alt: Randall, in a black T-shirt and grey shorts, strokes his chin thoughtfully and asks a question about dinosaurs, while Samantha, in a purple dress, stands beside him and whispers behind her hand.
transcript: Randall: Do you think t-rexs slept with their heads up against cliffs so that they could rest?
Samantha: ...nerd alert!

44.alt: Randall grips the wheel of a small blue car, looking panicked as he shouts, while Samantha throws her arms up in alarm in the passenger seat.
transcript: Randall: We have to get to 88 miles per hour!
Samantha: Why?!

45.alt: Samantha, carrying a purse, walks into a new home full of unopened moving boxes. Randall sits at a desk with only his laptop, a toilet paper roll and a glass set up, and Scribbles sits under the desk.
transcript: Samantha: Why is everything still in boxes?
Randall: I unpacked everything we need.

46.alt: Randall hugs Samantha from behind and nuzzles her while holding out a black laptop in front of her. Samantha looks sideways, unsure.
transcript: Randall: I love you so much that I'm going to give you my old laptop so that you can finally learn UNIX!
Samantha: I guess this means that we're taking our relationship to the next level!

47.alt: Samantha sets plates of food on a candlelit dinner table, but Randall is walking away from it, carrying his own plate and a candle.
transcript: Samantha: Honey, I made us a candlelit dinner!
Randall: Nope! There's a new OS update, and I have to try it before anyone else does!

48.alt: At a store checkout, a cashier turns his monitor to show a screen of error text. Randall, in an "rtfm" T-shirt, gleefully points at it, while Samantha, holding a shopping basket, looks embarrassed.
transcript: Cashier: I apologize. Our computers are down. I won't be able to ring you up today.
Randall: HAH! Your kernal updates messed up the NIC drivers!!

49.alt: Randall lies sprawled on the floor with X's for eyes as if dead. Samantha stands over him with a hand on her hip, and Scribbles lies on the floor nearby.
transcript: Randall: Ugh, I'm out of caffeine, and I can't get up to buy more!
Samantha: So, this is the END of you?
Randall: Essentially....yes.

50.alt: Samantha sits at her pink desk, where her monitor shows a blue error screen. Randall stands beside it, arms flung wide, screaming in horror.
transcript: Samantha: Hey babe, can you fix my computer?
Randall: Oh my god! It's the blue screen OF DEATH!!!

51.alt: Randall and Samantha lie in bed under a teal blanket. Randall rests with his hands behind his head, looking pleased, while Samantha looks over at him.
transcript: Randall: So while I was sleeping last night, I thought of the chapter titles for my new tech book!
Samantha: You dream of that stuff?

52.alt: Four panels: Samantha repeatedly checks on Randall, who sits in a green desk chair wearing headphones, his screen showing anime while he says he is working.
transcript: [Panel 1]
Samantha: How come whenever you're "working", you're actually watching anime?
Randall: Honey, I'm just waiting for my code to compile!
[Panel 2]
Samantha: It's been an hour, and you're still watching cartoons!
Randall: I'm waiting for my script to upload. It takes time...
[Panel 3]
Samantha: Hey you're still watching ANIME!
Randall: I'm taking a break, what do you expect?
[Panel 4]
Samantha: What about now?
Randall: I'm waiting for my data to populate!

53.alt: While shopping, Samantha tries on a green floppy hat with a price tag. Randall, beside her, pumps his fists excitedly.
transcript: Samantha: Will you buy me this hat?
Randall: You look like Link from Zelda! Of course I'll get it for you!
Samantha: I don't know who that is but okay!

54.alt: Samantha stands by Randall's desk and asks a question as he leans back in his chair with his feet up, typing on a laptop.
transcript: Samantha: How's Cora?
Randall: Cora was my old computer! This one is named Death, and he's doing just fine.

55.alt: Randall sits on an open Newegg box, smiling, while Samantha sits on the floor with her arms reaching deep inside a computer tower case, looking unhappy. Parts and cables lie around them.
transcript: Randall: Wow! We should build computers together more often... your fingers are the perfect size!

56.alt: Samantha holds a phone and reads off her apartment search, while Randall, holding a laptop and a water bottle, stands beside her.
transcript: Samantha: Ok... I've got all the potential apartments listed by square footage and cost....
Randall: The only thing that matters is the internet service provider!

57.alt: Two panels at a party: a man in a white T-shirt talks to Samantha, both holding red cups, and points out another man in a purple shirt across the room.
transcript: [Panel 1]
Samantha: I've never been to a Github sponsored party before...
Partygoer: Welcome. That guy over there is Kenneth Reitz, and he's a sex symbol.
[Panel 2]
Samantha: Ooohh!
Partygoer: Mm hmm. He got contacts instead of glasses.

58.alt: Two panels: Randall, hands on hips, asks Samantha a question and she answers happily with her eyes closed. In the second panel he looks unimpressed and she glares back.
transcript: [Panel 1]
Randall: What's your favorite number?
Samantha: 31!
[Panel 2]
Randall: That's so typical. You'd choose a whole number.

59.alt: Photo of a closet shelf with three tall stacks of folded T-shirts: printed tech shirts, plain white shirts, and plain black shirts, with a water bottle in front.
transcript: Caption: A Hacker's Wardrobe:
[Labels with arrows under each stack, left to right:]
Label: Tech shirts
Label: White shirts
Label: Black shirts

60.alt: A leasing agent points to a document on a table. Samantha sits across from them, and Randall stands behind her, staring at the pen in his hand.
transcript: Leasing agent: Sign your new lease in black pen on the dotted line...
Randall: I haven't used one of these in years!

61.alt: Two panels: Samantha asks Randall about going running. Below, she stands with hands on her hips, indignant, while Randall shrugs with palms up.
transcript: [Panel 1]
Samantha: How come you never go running with me?
Randall: The typical mammalian heart usually stops after two billion beats, so I try to avoid cardio at all costs.
[Panel 2]
Samantha: And you never told me?!

62.alt: Samantha sits on the floor holding a small game box, looking dismayed, next to an opened pink gift box. Randall sits across from her, gesturing at the gift.
transcript: Samantha: You got me Warcraft for my birthday?
Randall: What's wrong?

63.alt: Randall and Samantha at a candlelit anniversary dinner over spaghetti, with a "3 years" heart card on the table. Randall gestures mid-lecture while Samantha looks glazed over.
transcript: Randall: So that’s pretty much what a content delivery network is.
Samantha: Oh. Well, happy anniversary honey!
[A card on the table reads: 3 years]

64.alt: Randall stands with fists raised, shouting angrily, while Samantha stands beside him looking wide-eyed and impressed.
transcript: Randall: I could replace his job with a two line Bash script!
Samantha: Ooohh!

65.alt: Randall cheers with raised fists and Samantha frowns beside him as they watch a robotics competition, where a boxy robot loaded with balls and a smaller robot roll across the arena floor.
transcript: Randall: Robots! Epic! When do they start blowing each other up?
Samantha: How many times do I have to tell you? This is not that kind of contest!

66.alt: Two panels. Randall raises a finger to pitch a meetup idea to a smiling Samantha, then throws his hands up excitedly as she stands skeptically, holding Scribbles the chihuahua on a leash.
transcript: [Panel 1]
Randall: I have an idea for a meetup...
Samantha: A DoS attackers group? Hah!
[Panel 2]
Randall: No! A hackathon with... black lights and alcohol and hacker movies playing and loud music too! No rules! No set projects! No formalities!
Samantha: Oh no.

67.alt: Two panels. Samantha voices a money worry to Randall, who is seated in a green chair with a laptop. Then Randall throws his arms up triumphantly while Samantha stares, horrified.
transcript: [Panel 1]
Samantha: I’m worried that we’re not saving enough money for retirement.
Randall: Hmmm...
[Panel 2]
Randall: I spent ALL our savings on Bitcoin! You don’t have to save or worry ever again!
Samantha: Oh god!

68.alt: Randall lies stretched out on the floor with his laptop, clutching his face and yelling at the screen. Samantha stands over him with a hand on her hip, unimpressed, as he explains himself.
transcript: [Panel 1]
Randall: Null? Batch request denied?! NOOOOOOOOO!
[Panel 2]
Samantha: You’ve been laying here all day talking to yourself!
[Panel 3]
Randall: I’m testing my API! I have to watch it run and catch errors...
[Panel 4]
Samantha: Then you just lay there after they arise?
Randall: Yes. I’m going to fix them later. This is an important part! Trust me!

69.alt: Samantha swoons with raised arms in front of a pink heart, professing her love to Randall. He responds with a literal-minded question, leaving her facepalming and then clutching her head.
transcript: [Panel 1]
Samantha: Baby! I’m head over heels for you!
Randall: I have never understood what that means... Isn’t one’s head always over one’s heels? Why would it be something worthy of pointing out?
[Samantha facepalms.]
[Panel 2]
Samantha: ...it means I really like you!
Randall: Wha? How on earth do you get that?

70.alt: Randall and Samantha eat tacos, then later in a grocery store Randall holds up a bag of Doritos and shouts excitedly while Samantha stands by a shopping cart looking embarrassed.
transcript: [Panel 1]
Randall: Wow! Dorito-flavored tacos!
[Panel 2]
[In a grocery store, Randall holds up a bag of Doritos with a taco pictured on it.]
Randall: Hey! These new Doritos are flavored like the taco, that’s flavored like the doritos!
Randall: It’s INFINITE RECURSION!

71.alt: Samantha, sitting at her laptop, complains to Randall about an online zombie game. In the next panel Randall hugs her with a proud, contented smile while she looks glum.
transcript: [Panel 1]
Samantha: Dude! The zombie hoard was coming and my teammate died- so I used the defibrillators on him and then- he got up and killed me for no reason!
[Panel 2]
Randall: I’m just proud that you’re gaming, sweetie!

72.alt: On a road trip, Randall stares suspiciously at a field full of golden haystacks, and Samantha gestures toward them to explain.
transcript: [Panel 1]
Randall: What is this?
[Panel 2]
Randall: Is this a sick cult of people who cube weeds?
[Panel 3]
Samantha: Those are called haystacks.
Randall: Oh.

73.alt: Two panels labeled "Most Couples" and "Us". In both, Randall glares over Samantha's shoulder as she uses her laptop, but for different reasons; a big "Nope!" burst ends the second panel.
transcript: Caption: Most Couples:
Randall: Hey, who’s that guy that’s poking you on facebook? That’s flirting, and you should never talk to him again.
Caption: Us:
Randall: Who’s this guy posting on your facebook in all caps? Ew! And he’s using Comic Sans?
Randall: Nope!

74.alt: Randall lies sprawled on the floor with X's for eyes, a hand raised dramatically, while Samantha stands over him gesturing in exasperation.
transcript: Randall: Nooo! It’s amazing how a slow internet connection can ruin your life! Ugh! Facepalm!
Samantha: Randall! There are other things in life. And-what the hell is facepalm?
Randall: Double Facepalm!

75.alt: Randall excitedly tells Samantha, who is eating a banana, about another couple he met, gesturing enthusiastically as she listens with a flat expression.
transcript: [Panel 1]
Randall: I met a graphic designer that’s married to a programmer!
[Panel 2]
Randall: Don’t you see how that’s perfect?!
Randall: He codes the back end, while she designs the front end!
Samantha: Oh

76.alt: In a parking lot, Samantha gestures indignantly at a reserved parking sign next to a row of cars while Randall looks on, then Randall grins and makes a proposal of his own.
transcript: [Panel 1]
Samantha: Expectant mother parking? You gotta be kidding me! What about energy efficient vehicles?!
[Panel 2]
Randall: What about hackers?! Seriously, we should get priority parking!

77.alt: Samantha holds hands with Randall at a concert, smiling, but Randall looks glum and admits something about how he feels away from his computer.
transcript: [Panel 1]
Samantha: Isn’t this fun?!
Randall: Actually...
[Panel 2]
Randall: I always want to code whenever I leave my desk.
[Panel 3]
Samantha: Why?
Randall: Because everything offline sucks.
Samantha: Oh no...

78.alt: Randall grins and steeples his fingers as Samantha's phone rings. She answers to a strange automated message, then angrily confronts Randall while he laughs.
transcript: [Panel 1]
Phone: Ring! ring!
[Panel 2]
Samantha: Hello?
Phone: This is yourself from the future...I want you to know--
[Panel 3]
Samantha: Randall! STOP testing your phone apps on me--or else!
Randall: Muahahaha!

79.alt: Randall relaxes in a clawfoot bubble bath with candles, reading an "html 5" book, while Samantha stands beside the tub in a towel, glaring at him.
transcript: Samantha: You’re reading about HTML in your bubble bath?
Randall: It relaxes me.
[The book cover reads: html 5]

80.alt: Samantha delightedly shows Randall a pilgrim name generator on her laptop at their Thanksgiving table, and Randall's bored look turns to indignation at the result.
transcript: [Panel 1]
Samantha: Omg! A pilgrim name generator!
[Panel 2]
Randall: Oh, that will make this so much more fun.
[Panel 3]
Samantha: It says you’re Cuthbert Cuthbertson! And Scribbles is Cuthbert Cuthbertson too!
Randall: What?!
Randall: Whoever made that forgot to seed the random number generator!

81.alt: Samantha, walking Scribbles on a leash, asks Randall about his upcoming conference. As he cheerfully explains the name, she nervously clutches Scribbles.
transcript: [Panel 1]
Samantha: So....why is the conference that you’re going to called Defcon?
Randall: Oh! It’s named after a scale, that the government uses, to describe a level of threat...
[Panel 2]
Samantha: -gulp!
Randall: For example, a nuclear war would be a level of Defcon one!

82.alt: Out holiday shopping, Randall spots an office supply store and gets starry-eyed. Samantha, carrying shopping bags, shoots him down, and later drives the car while he holds his head.

Randall: ooooh...
